visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Thin light-grey (subtle gradient) band; four items in one centered row: price, change, timestamp, 'View stock information' link.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Compact one-line stock ticker band: price, change, timestamp and a link to stock information
visualCharacteristics.description: Single compact centered row of four inline items: price, change, timestamp, arrow link

contentPattern.summary: Fixed set of four different items side by side in one row that never wraps into a grid (price, change, timestamp, link); values are live stock data that the block can refresh. Stat values stay as paragraphs, not headings.
contentPattern.structure: one row with four cells: price (e.g. T: $21.85) | change (e.g. ↑ $+0.05) | timestamp | link (View stock information). Optional extra single-cell row with a link to a .json feed for the live-data option

usage: Thin band under the home hero showing the AT&T (T) quote.
reuseGuidance: Use only for the stock ticker. For general side-by-side content use columns.
